map.校正核算：叠加多芯、敷设方式与环境温度校正系数: Correction accounting: superpose multi-core, laying-method and ambient-temperature correction factors.
map.经济性评估：按利用率判断截面是否偏大或偏小: Economy assessment: judge from utilization whether the section is oversized or undersized.
map.算法：温度系数 tf = 1.0（t≤30℃）、0.50（t≥60℃）、否则 1: Algorithm: temperature factor tf = 1.0 (t<=30 deg C), 0.50 (t>=60 deg C), else 1.0-(t-30) times 0.0167; corrected current = calculated current/(multi-core factor times laying factor times temperature factor); pick the first standard rating >= corrected current in the copper table 1.5/18, 2.5/25, 4/34, 6/43, 10/60, 16/80, 25/105, 35/130, 50/160, 70/200, 95/245, 120/285, 150/325, 185/370, 240/435, 300/495, 400/580 (mm2/A); corrected rating = base rating times combined factor; utilization = calculated current/corrected rating times 100%; transmitted power = sqrt(3) times U times I/1000 (kW). Assessment: utilization >85% suggest one step up, >50% well matched, <30% consider one step down.
Example: 100 A, three core (0.87), 380 V, open air (1.0), 30 deg C -> tf 1.00, corrected current 114.94 A, pick 35 mm2 (base 130 A), combined 0.87, corrected rating 113 A, utilization 88%, transmitted power 65.8 kW, hint: high utilization, suggest one step up (to 50 mm2: corrected rating 139 A, utilization 71.8%). If changed to 200 A, 45 deg C -> tf 0.75, corrected current 306.72 A, pick 150 mm2 (325 A), combined 0.65, corrected rating 212 A, utilization 94%, transmitted power 131.6 kW, also suggest one step up.

map.多根电缆成束敷设时相互加热、散热变差，载流量需折减。0.87 对应常见 3 芯成: When several cables are bundled, they heat each other and dissipate worse, so current capacity must be derated. 0.87 corresponds to a common 3-core bundled simplified value; in practice look up the correction table by number of cables, laying method (tray/conduit/burial) and spacing; heavily bundled can go down to 0.6 to 0.7, ignoring it causes chronic cable overheating.
